metadata.name: Rounded Stackable Storage Bin
metadata.description: 3D-printable rounded stackable parametric storage bin. Rounded-rectangle body with a 45-degree top rim funnel (female receiver) and a 45-degree self-supporting foot taper (male) sized so a bin wedges into the one below and self-centres. The exterior wall is flat: proud ribs were removed because a rib underside is an unsupported overhang -- use slicer fuzzy skin for exterior texture instead. Both tapers use inset_faces, so their corners mitre themselves cleanly on the rounded outline. Fully parametric: bin_width, bin_depth, bin_height, bin_wall, bin_radius, bin_rim_chamfer, bin_foot_chamfer, bin_rib_height, bin_hole_size and per-band vent flags bin_holes_1..3.
